flows.text:
version = 1
name = "Docs pass"
description = "A writer updates the documentation, a checker compares it with the code"
end = "pull_request"

[orchestrator]
agent = "claude"
prompt = "Keep every message self-contained."

[[role]]
name = "writer"
agent = "claude"
edits = true
prompt = "You are the writer. Update the docs to match the code. Commit locally."

[[role]]
name = "checker"
agent = "codex"
prompt = "You check docs against code. Do not edit files.\nAnswer with findings or No findings."

[[stage]]
roles = ["writer"]

[[stage]]
roles = ["checker"]

[stage.back]
to = 1
when = "findings"
at_most = 2
